reviews.body: The fix correctly closes a billing gap by tracking usage for all finish reasons (STOP, MAX_TOKENS, SAFETY), not just STOP. The logic is sound: any finish reason marks a final response that's billed. The test covers the three key cases and verifies both local and global callback paths. The comment explains why this matters. Ready to merge.

review_comments.body: Using `candidate.get("finish_reason")` is cleaner than the old two-clause check and safely handles missing keys while remaining truthy for any non-empty finish reason string. The comment correctly explains that streaming chunks (no finish reason) are still skipped. Non-blocking.
